about.text: Fan-made skin site covering 1,947 skins across 173 champions: splash and loading art, 3D model with chromas, skin spotlight, popularity (measured in poros from SkinSpotlights views), obtainability ratings, skinlines, brackets and tier lists, personal collection saved in the browser, and a Worlds section.

data_sources.text: Art and game data from Riot Games (Data Dragon and Universe) and CommunityDragon; release dates, prices, availability and credits from Meraki Analytics; rebuilt regularly so new skins appear after each patch.
